OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: The period of time to await between two runs of the connector.

VULMATCH_API_KEY.description: The Vulmatch API key used for authentication.

VULMATCH_SBOM_ONLY.description: Only ingest vulnerabilities related to products in your Vulmatch SBoM (`true`), or every vulnerability that matches the filters (`false`).

VULMATCH_CVSS_V2_SCORE_MIN.description: The minimum CVSS v2 base score of the vulnerabilities to ingest, as an integer between 1 and 10. Set to -1 to disable this filter.

VULMATCH_CVSS_V3_SCORE_MIN.description: The minimum CVSS v3 base score of the vulnerabilities to ingest, as an integer between 1 and 10. Set to -1 to disable this filter.

VULMATCH_CVSS_V4_SCORE_MIN.description: The minimum CVSS v4 base score of the vulnerabilities to ingest, as an integer between 1 and 10. Set to -1 to disable this filter.

VULMATCH_EPSS_SCORE_MIN.description: The minimum EPSS score of the vulnerabilities to ingest, between 0 and 1. Set to -1 to disable this filter.

VULMATCH_DAYS_TO_BACKFILL.description: The number of days of historical data to import on the first run (capped at 365).
